BJP workers also showed black flags to Rahul Gandhi in Mumbai, accusing the Congress of an 'anti-national' act and demanding an apology for the 'shameful' summit disruption.
title: BJP protests nationwide in response to Congress' 'topless' AI Summit protest

author: TOI BUSINESS DESK
description: President Trump signed a proclamation imposing a 10% temporary import surcharge on most goods, effective February 24 for 150 days. This action, taken under emergency powers, aims to address significant balance-of-payments deficits and encourage domestic manufacturing. Broad exemptions are included for economic necessity and national interest.
title: 'Effective from February 24': All you need to know about Trump's new 10% global tariffs

author: TNN
description: A 19-year-old student was allegedly confined, assaulted, and raped by her live-in partner in Gurgaon after a dispute.  The victim sustained burns and was hospitalized. Police arrested the accused, also 19, from Delhi.  The incident reportedly stemmed from arguments over her activities, with families aware of the relationship and discussing marriage.
title: Gurgaon horror: 19-year-old confined, assaulted, raped by live-in partner

author: TOI NEWS DESK
title: 'Hats off': Cong praises US SC verdict on Trump tariffs, hails 'American system of checks & balance'

author: NIKHIL SHARMA
description: A tragic marital dispute in Faridabad culminated in the fatal shooting of 32-year-old Sangeeta by her husband, Dilip Yadav. The couple, who were undergoing divorce proceedings, had a heated argument at her parents' home. Dilip allegedly fired multiple shots, killing Sangeeta instantly before fleeing the scene.
title: Heated arguments, then multiple gunshots: Man shoots wife dead over marital dispute in Faridabad

author: TANUJ LAKHINA
description: IPL franchises’ pre-season camps are scattered across India, even overseas and it underscores a worrying drift from the idea of “home.” By training and sometimes playing matches far from their base cities, teams dilute fan connection, culture, and home advantage. If cities remain interchangeable pit stops, the Indian Premier League risks becoming a travelling show with no real roots.
title: Home-and-away or away-and-away? IPL franchise's bizarre training stops

author: TOI BUSINESS DESK
description: India will now face a 10% tariff on imports to the US, as President Trump signed an executive order imposing this global rate. This move follows a US Supreme Court ruling that declared his previous tariffs illegal. Trump stated that this new tariff structure is a reversal, with India now paying tariffs to the US.
title: How much tariff will India pay after US SC ruling? What White House said

author: TOI SPORTS DESK
description: Cricketer Hardik Pandya celebrated Mahieka Sharma's 25th birthday with a heartfelt Instagram post featuring a romantic video. Sharma reciprocated the affection, calling Pandya her "best gift." The couple, who confirmed their relationship in October 2025, has been seen together publicly since. Pandya was previously married to Natasa Stankovic.
title: 'I love my man': Mahieka Sharma's romantic reply to Hardik Pandya goes viral

author: TOI WORLD DESK
description: Israeli air strikes in Lebanon's Bekaa Valley killed at least 12 and wounded 50, targeting Hezbollah command centres. A senior Hezbollah leader was reportedly among the dead. These strikes, among the deadliest recently, risk straining a fragile US-brokered ceasefire. Earlier, an Israeli strike in Sidon killed two Hamas members.
title: Israel launches strike on Lebanon; 10 dead including senior Hezbollah leader —video shows aftermath

author: TOI CITY DESK
description: Delhi faces a terror threat alert near the Red Fort. Intelligence suggests Lashkar-e-Taiba may target a temple in Chandni Chowk with an IED. This potential strike aims to avenge a recent mosque blast in Pakistan. Prominent religious sites across India are on the group's radar. Security has been heightened in the capital's sensitive areas.
title: Lashkar-e-Taiba 'plotting' IED attack in Delhi's Chandni Chowk area: Report

author: TOI CITY DESK
description: Prime Minister Modi will inaugurate the Meerut Metro and Namo Bharat train, flagging off India's first Regional Rapid Transit System. He will also ride the train and dedicate development projects worth Rs 12,930 crore. This integrated system connects Delhi with Meerut, promising faster intercity travel and transforming regional transit.
title: Namo Bharat at 160 kmph, Meerut Metro at 120 kmph: High-speed infra push for commuters

author: DWAIPAYAN DATTA
description: The Super 8 stage kicks off with a crucial clash between Pakistan and New Zealand in Colombo. Pakistan holds a slight edge due to their spin attack, particularly mystery spinner Usman Tariq. New Zealand, familiar with Pakistan's bowling, will rely on their middle order to counter the threat.
title: New Zealand wary of Usman Tariq threat but back familiarity against Pakistan

author: TOI SPORTS DESK
description: Pakistan and New Zealand clash in a pivotal T20 World Cup Super 8 match at Colombo. With a near-even head-to-head record, this encounter promises high drama. Both teams have shown inconsistent form, making this fixture crucial for semi-final aspirations. Rain threatens to disrupt the contest, with no reserve day available.
title: PAK vs NZ Super 8s weather forecast: What happens if rain washes out Colombo clash?

author: TOI LIFESTYLE DESK
description: Arunima Sinha, a national volleyball player, defied unimaginable odds after a brutal train incident led to her leg's amputation. Despite physical and emotional trauma, she resolved to conquer Mount Everest. Her relentless training and unwavering spirit culminated in her becoming the first Indian female amputee to summit the world's highest peak, inspiring millions with her resilience.
title: 'Pushed me off a moving train': How Arunima Sinha became 1st woman amputee to climb Mt Everest

author: TOI ENTERTAINMENT DESK
description: In a shocking development, Bollywood star Ranveer Singh has found himself at the center of an extortion case, allegedly targeted by Harry Boxer of the notorious Bishnoi gang. A threatening voice note from a US number has prompted the Mumbai Police to issue a Look Out Circular for Boxer, intensifying their investigation into a staggering Rs 20 crore ransom demand.
title: Ranveer Singh extortion threat: Mumbai crime branch issues lookout circular against Harry Boxer

author: TOI ENTERTAINMENT DESK
description: Celebrated actors Rashmika Mandanna and Vijay Deverakonda are reportedly set to marry this month in Udaipur. Ahead of their nuptials, the popular pair will collaborate on a new ad, following their previous successful soap commercial.  The couple is prioritizing a highly private wedding ceremony with stringent security measures, with a grand reception planned for March 4th in Hyderabad.
title: Rashmika Mandanna and Vijay Deverakonda to do Ad shoot before their Udaipur wedding

author: HIJAM RAJU SINGH
description: The T20 World Cup's Super 8 stage marks the true beginning of the tournament, with India facing a tough path in Group 1. Despite an unbeaten group stage, concerns linger over opener Abhishek Sharma's form and the team's fielding ahead of crucial matches against South Africa, Zimbabwe, and the West Indies.
title: T20 World Cup 2026: How worried should India be about their Super 8 opponents

author: TOI WORLD DESK
description: At the heart of the case was whether Trump could use emergency powers under a national-security law to impose broad tariffs on imports. The Supreme Court ruled that the statute did not authorise such sweeping action. It held that tariffs are essentially a form of taxation, and under the Constitution, the power to impose taxes rests with Congress.
title: Tariff ruling: Meet the Trump-appointed Supreme Court judges who went against him

author: TOI BUSINESS DESK
description: The Supreme Court invalidated Trump's tariffs, leaving billions in collected duties in limbo. While the administration previously promised refunds, the process remains unclear, with individual importers potentially needing to file lawsuits. This ruling, which affirmed Congress's power to tax, has left companies and countries awaiting further guidance.
title: The $170bn question: US SC junks Trump tariffs, but who will get the refunds?

author: TOI WORLD DESK
description: The US is significantly increasing its military presence in the Middle East with two aircraft carrier strike groups deployed amid rising tensions with Iran. President Trump is reportedly considering a narrow nuclear deal while Pentagon officials explore options ranging from diplomacy to targeting Iranian leadership. This buildup includes the USS Gerald R.
title: Trump offers Khamenei 'token' deal as US continues major military buildup in Middle East

author: TOI SPORTS DESK
description: Despite a dominant nine-wicket victory over Oman and Adam Zampa's four-wicket haul, Australia's early exit from the ICC Men's T20 World Cup 2026 cast a shadow.  Captain Mitchell Marsh also contributed a quickfire half-century, but individual performances offered little solace as the team expressed deep disappointment with their tournament's premature conclusion.
title: 'We failed': Australia star's painful dressing room confession after T20 World Cup exit

author: TOI WORLD DESK
description: Neal Katyal, son of Indian immigrants, led the legal team that successfully challenged President Trump's global tariffs. The Supreme Court's 6-3 ruling affirmed that only Congress, not the President, holds the power to tax Americans, marking a significant victory for constitutional limits on executive authority.
title: Who is Neal Katyal? Indian-American lawyer at center of Trump's biggest legal setback

author: TOI BUSINESS DESK
description: The Supreme Court ruled that President Trump lacked the authority under the International Emergency Economic Powers Act (IEEPA) to impose broad tariffs. The 6-3 decision found the law does not explicitly grant power for tariffs, a move Trump had used extensively. This ruling could lead to significant refunds and ongoing disputes over presidential tariff powers.
title: Why US Supreme Court struck down Donald Trump's trade tariffs; explained in 10 points

author: ABHAY
description: A 25-year-old Zepto delivery executive tragically lost his life after his electric scooter was struck by a car in West Delhi's Tilak Nagar. Eyewitnesses reported the car hit the scooter from behind, causing fatal injuries. The 27-year-old driver, a Municipal Corporation contractor, has been taken into custody as police investigate the incident further.
title: Zomato delivery boy killed after speeding car rams bike in Delhi; driver held

author: TOI LIFESTYLE DESK
description: Aristotle, a pivotal figure in Western philosophy, moved from Plato's abstract Forms to empirical observation, influencing science, ethics, and politics. He established the Lyceum, developed logic and metaphysics, and emphasized virtue and practical wisdom for achieving eudaimonia, or human flourishing. His enduring legacy lies in making philosophy practical and accessible.
title: 'It is not the handsomest or strongest men who are...': Quote of the day by Aristotle

description: Microsoft has appointed Asha Sharma as the new CEO of its gaming division, succeeding Phil Spencer. Sharma, with a background in AI and platform leadership, aims to refocus on Xbox's core audience amidst industry challenges like slowing revenue and intense competition. This significant leadership shift signals a strategic reset for Xbox.
title: Meet Asha Sharma: Indian-origin executive named CEO of Microsoft Gaming

author: PRANTIK PRABAL ROY
description: Kamila Sellier suffered a frightening facial injury during the women’s 1,500-meter short-track quarterfinal at the 2026 Winter Olympics after a collision caused by an illegal pass. She received stitches and further medical care, while Kristen Santos-Griswold was penalized. The incident paused the event and deeply affected competitors and spectators. Racing later resumed, but Sellier’s injury became one of the most sobering moments of the Games.
title: Olympic speedskater Kamila Sellier cut in fall, eye reportedly safe

description: Pakistan's head coach Mike Hesson rejected claims that dropping Shaheen Afridi and demoting Babar Azam against Namibia were reactions to their loss against India. description: Infosys CEO Salil Parekh reassures that AI will augment, not decimate, IT jobs, projecting a thriving Indian IT industry by 2030. description: The FBI has issued a warning about ATM jackpotting malware, like Ploutus, which allows threat actors to dispense cash by exploiting physical and software vulnerabilities.
